claims.text: Many reviewers report noticeable teeth whitening after consistent use, though some note it takes time to see results.
Reviewers frequently praise the minty taste and foaming action, with several noting it is not messy like other charcoal products.
Several reviewers consider the product a good value, mentioning the included bamboo toothbrushes and multiple jars for the price.
A few reviewers say they saw little or no difference in whitening, especially in the short term.
Some reviewers mention the product is messy or hard to rinse off.
